description: The plot titled “ChatGPT on Songs” illustrates how three metrics (Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment) vary as a function of Answer Popularity. The x-axis is labeled “Answer Popularity,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 10 to 160 with labeled ticks at 40, 60, 80, 100, 120, 140, and 160. The y-axis is labeled “Values,” uses a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0, with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.2 intervals. Three solid lines with markers are shown: the Accuracy series is a blue solid line with circular markers, starting near 0.55 at the lowest popularity, dipping to about 0.48 around popularity 20, then rising to about 0.76 at 40 and about 0.82 at 50–60, reaching about 0.88 near 95, and ending around 0.84 at the highest popularity. The Confidence series is a green solid line with upward triangle markers, starting around 0.92, staying in the low-to-high 0.9 range across the axis, reaching about 0.98 near 95, and ending around 0.97 near the highest popularity. The Alignment series is a red solid line with square markers, starting around 0.63, dropping to about 0.58 near 20, increasing to about 0.81 at 40 and about 0.85 at 50–60, reaching about 0.90 near 95, then moving to about 0.85 near 120 and ending around 0.87 at the highest popularity.
